author: More Perfect Union
description:
Arizona has a huge school voucher program, and the money is being spent in shocking ways — lingerie, Xboxes, Disney vacations.

The vouchers were sold as helping poor kids, but the money is going to rich families and private schools, while public schools close and suffer.
